notes: Cut Allowance Workbench Shortcut. Promotes the existing Build073 3-inch Cut Allowance Ledger to a visible Material Efficiency section near the top of Carpet Workbench. The shortcut reads the already-rendered ledger instead of recalculating a second data set, so Month, Quarter, Half-Year and Inventory Year numbers always match the detailed analytics. Shows cuts, extra linear length and allowance area at a glance and opens the detailed ledger with one tap. No inventory, cutting, Cloud Master or Supabase business logic is changed.
